Found by #25 during the referee rerun (2026-11-09). store.ts `quoteFound`, the check that a Quote is verbatim from the Source's stored text, doesn't treat curly quotes and straight quotes as the same character. A referee reply quoting `"I wish to be of the opposite sex"` was refused because the stored text has `“…”`. It passed on a retry, but this will keep refusing good replies now and then, and each refusal costs a retry call.

- Reproduce it as a failing test first. Then fold typographic look-alikes into one character inside the comparison only: “ ” „ ″ to ", ‘ ’ ‚ ′ to '.
- The stored text and the Quote as shown stay byte-for-byte as they are. Only the check gets looser.
- Check that the extract, referee and Check-harder paths all go through the same check.

Two bugs from Cara (2026-11-11) in the release Android app, mandate-1.apk (versionCode 1). Her words: "back in the app shouldnt go to citadel, clicking on the today widget should always open the today view".

1. **Back goes to Citadel.** The system Back gesture or button in the app should stay inside Mandate: it closes an open sheet first, steps back through Mandate's own views, leaves the app at Mandate's root, and never lands on a Citadel page. Both fixes are probably native, so this makes the next release, mandate-2.apk.

Code health covers what the changes on main left messier than they found it. Scope: `git log --since='30 days ago' main` and the 10 files those commits touched most. Not the whole repo.

Cara, 2026-11-22, after buying GitHub Pro: "Are there ways we can leverage github CI that will speed up our processes without instantly hitting that 3k cap? maybe smaller/medium jobs could move there to free up our CI for the bigger stuff?"

The Taskmaster offered: "One test run of Citadel's suite on a GitHub runner (about 20 of the 3,000 minutes) settles how slow it is there. Then it designs an overflow lane: only small jobs, only when our runners are busy, and it stops itself at about 80% of the month's allowance. Ships only on your go."
